package.description: Automated exchange of data between cloud applications, databases and files on Windows, MacOS and Linux devices.

en-US.description: Automated exchange of data between cloud applications, databases and files on Windows, MacOS and Linux devices.
en-US.longDescription: Invantive Data Hub transports data between cloud applications, relational databases and files in one integrated solution. Invantive Data Hub scales from small to large enterprises through the solid foundation on Invantive UniversalSQL, including many complex data filters, and transparant parallel execution using high-performance streaming of data for SQL queries. Invantive Data Hub reliably handles large volumes of data on Windows, MacOS and Linux. The headless capability eases integration with the task scheduler of choice such as Windows Task Scheduler or the Linux cron daemon.
en-US.name: Invantive Data Hub

zh-CN.description: 在 Windows、MacOS 和 Linux 设备上实现云应用、数据库与文件之间的自动化数据交换。
zh-CN.longDescription: Invantive Data Hub 是一款集成化解决方案，可在云应用程序、关系型数据库和文件之间高效传输数据。基于稳固的 Invantive UniversalSQL 技术基础，它支持从中小企业到大型企业的灵活扩展，包含多种复杂数据过滤器，并通过高性能数据流实现 SQL 查询的透明并行执行。该系统能稳定处理 Windows、MacOS 和 Linux 平台上的海量数据，其无界面（headless）特性可轻松与各类任务调度程序（如 Windows 任务计划程序或 Linux 的 cron 守护进程）集成。
